newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends slightly weaker, seen basing.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends slightly weaker, seen basing.

text.p: COMEX copper ended slightly weaker in steady trade with relatively good volume, helping the market to cling on to most of the sharp gains notched up in the previous session.
"I think the consolidation at the higher levels is pretty impressive," a trader said.
Although copper hit resistance on the highs, it did not fall back in any significant way. "It's mustering strength for an assault on the upside," the trader added.
Technically the market was said to look good with much of the tightness in the LME cash premium over three months situated in January.
The premium was at $133/$138 by close of COMEX, up slightly from early Tuesday's level.
March COMEX copper settled 0.35 cent weaker at 104.80 cents per pound, traded 105.70 to 104.20 cents. Spot January went out 1.20 cents lower at 107.00 cents.
Volume was estimated at 10,000 lots, down from Tuesday's official 17,118 lots.
COMEX stocks on Wednesday rose 267 short tons to 30,187 short tons.
